chile: part of the song title 'Voodoo Chile' by Jimi Hendrix
The astronaut said 'Voodoo Chile' reminded him of Earth's night sky.
made: The table was made entirely from reclaimed wood.
list: a set of items written one after another
She made a list of groceries before going to the market.
wake-up: used to describe music or a call that wakes someone in the morning
The astronauts listened to a wake-up song chosen by mission control.
songs: short pieces of music with words, meant to be sung
The band played several songs from their new album.
sts-110: the designation of a NASA space shuttle mission
STS-110 delivered a new truss segment to the space station.
report: to give information about something officially
Witnesses are encouraged to report any suspicious activity.
history: the study of past events, or a record of the past
She studied the history of ancient Rome at university.
division: the act of splitting something into parts, or a part of an organization
The company's sales division reported strong growth this quarter.
